title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?
text:
At the equator the ground moves about 1,040 mph (1,675 km/h). If the planet stopped, everything not attached to it would keep going east. Afterwards one day would last a year, and with the equatorial bulge gone the oceans would settle at the poles around one huge equatorial continent.

Send this to the friend who hates roller coasters.
